title: Oral check record sheet (teacher)
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: At the airport; at the seaport; my summer holiday
source: Written for arabic/y5 lesson 13 (Oral check record sheet (teacher))
intro: Oral check: ask each pupil the four questions on camera, one at a time, while the class does the written check. Score each answer 0 to 2.

arabic.text:
سَافَرَ يُوسُفُ إِلَى مِصْرَ بِالسَّفِينَةِ.
زَارَ خَالَهُ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَى النِّيلِ.
كَانَ الجَوُّ جَمِيلًا.
arabic.ref: Our own text for the Year 5 check
